description.html: This 120x40x50 cm glass terrarium with a volume of 240 liters comes with a handmade 3D background that gives the interior the look of a natural habitat. The polystyrene background is sculpted as rock, tree bark or cave relief, and every piece is unique because it is made by hand in our workshop.

A length of 120 cm and a width of 40 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. The floor dimensions allow a basking spot at one end and a cooler hide at the other. The ventilation openings are placed to create natural airflow from bottom to top, which maintains optimal humidity.

When ordering, you choose the decorative film, the 3D background style and the ventilation type. Non-standard dimensions, LED lighting and a thermostat are available as options. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for full details. Delivery across Serbia.
